{#- vp_example: a live example, for a page's markdown: a component's example file (components//examples/.html, copied into docs/examples/ by scripts/build-docs.mjs, since zola reads only inside the site), shown in a frame of its own, over the same markup as code. {{ }} The frame is a page as an app's is: Tailwind's preflight, vpkit and its components (static/example.css, from scripts/build-docs.mjs; the docs theme's examples, kit="docs-theme", load static/example-docs-theme.css, its variables, icons and components over the kit), with none of the markdown's styles, which would restyle a component's links, paragraphs and headings. static/example.js keeps it in the page's appearance and as tall as its content. file: the example, /; title: the frame's name for assistive technology; layout: how the frame lays out the elements, as the page's flow does (the default), "row" (side by side, wrapping, 1rem apart) or "stack" (one under another as wide as the frame, 1rem apart); min_height: a height the frame keeps for what is out of its flow (a modal dialog, a fixed toast) or sized by the viewport, which in the frame is the frame (a dropdown's panel). A blank line would end the raw HTML in the markdown, so srcdoc carries the line breaks as . -#} {% component vp_example(file, title, layout="", min_height="", kit="") -%} {%- if layout not in ["", "row", "stack"] -%} {{ throw(message="vpkit docs: a vp_example's layout is \"row\", \"stack\" or left out, not " ~ layout) }} {%- endif -%} {%- if kit not in ["", "docs-theme"] -%} {{ throw(message="vpkit docs: a vp_example's kit is \"docs-theme\" or left out, not " ~ kit) }} {%- endif -%} {%- set newline = ` ` -%} {%- set markup = load_data(path="examples/" ~ file ~ ".html", format="plain") | trim -%} {%- set stylesheet = "example-docs-theme.css" if kit == "docs-theme" else "example.css" -%} {%- set frame = `` ~ markup ~ `` -%} ```html {{ markup | safe }} ``` {%- endcomponent vp_example %}
